body:
## Context
1. Issue #210: `runTicketPrune` in `packages/ticket-prune/lib/run.mjs` returns its dry-run or empty-state result before calling `detectTicketStore`, bypassing pending-transaction (`RECOVERY_REQUIRED`) detection on the directory ticket store.
2. Issue #315: Whole-file mutation of `packages/fleet/lib/live-deps.mjs` leaves 3 surviving mutants in `ensureLocalExclude` (lines 52 and 58).

## Changes
1. In `packages/ticket-prune/lib/run.mjs`, resolve `detectTicketStore` before loading tickets or returning early on dry-run / empty store so pending directory transactions (`RECOVERY_REQUIRED`) fail closed with `{ ok: false, error }` in both dry-run and write modes. Add unit tests in `packages/ticket-prune/test/run.test.mjs`.
2. Export `ensureLocalExclude` from `packages/fleet/lib/live-deps.mjs` and add unit tests in `packages/fleet/test/live-deps.test.mjs` covering all 4 entries in `want` and both branches of the newline-joining guard (`cur === ""`, `cur.endsWith("\n")`, and non-newline-terminated existing content) so zero mutants survive.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `runTicketPrune` (including dry-run and empty store) returns `{ ok: false, error }` matching `/unfinished ticket transaction|RECOVERY_REQUIRED/` when `.adlc/tickets/.tx/` has a pending recovery journal. Verify: `node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/run.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC2: `ensureLocalExclude` kills all array-literal-shrink, invert-comparison, and logic-swap mutants in `packages/fleet/lib/live-deps.mjs`. Verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/live-deps.test.mjs` exits 0.
title: fix(ticket-prune,fleet): detect pending directory transactions on dry-run and kill live-deps survivors (#210, #315)
